snippet.title: Weaponized Racing Goes Full Chaos | RACE – Steam Trailer
snippet.description:
Get ready for high-speed arcade racing where winning takes more than just driving fast.

⭐ Add RACE: Rocket Arena Car Extreme to your Steam Wishlist!

RACE: Rocket Arena Car Extreme combines intense racing with explosive vehicular combat. Use weapons, nitro boosts, special abilities and aggressive driving to destroy your rivals and fight your way to the finish line.

🔥 Battle opponents with powerful weapons
🏎️ Unlock and upgrade unique combat cars
💥 Use special abilities to dominate the track
🏁 Race through action-packed tracks and game modes
⚙️ Customize your cars and build your ultimate racing machine

Speed alone won’t save you. Fight, boost, crash and survive.

Add RACE: Rocket Arena Car Extreme to your Steam Wishlist and get ready to enter the arena.
